name: Portrait Performance — Local
description: Animate a frontal photographic portrait from a square human performance crop. Retains reference appearance in the tested frontal examples; small frontal movements work best. Larger turns, blinks and angled paintings can distort. Portrait output only; no scene or body replacement.
license: MIT (workflow, adapter and pinned LivePortrait core/weights); ComfyUI GPL-3.0. No InsightFace code or weights installed.

provenance.coreOnly: Direct LivePortraitWrapper. No automatic cropper, InsightFace, detector or external landmark models. Relative keypoint motion plus stitching, global motion gain, 512px decoded portrait.
provenance.qualityEvidence: 2026-10-23 actual app SDK/proxy/Comfy runs: modern frontal human33frames16fpsgain1.0,36.9s; expanded crop rerun33.6s; historicalhuman25frames24fpsgain0.35,26.1s. Same-runtime portable ZIP replay24.7s, all25decodedframes equal, no cachednodes. Eyelid motion transfers approximately; closed eyelids soften/darken. Large-turn painting tests showed ghosting; not universal identity/scene replacement.

portrait.motion: Relative motion scaled by the visible motion amount; no same-amplitude promise.
